scope: Actual globally Lipschitz weighted hard primitive, uniformly in all other thresholds

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussian_exp_sq_polynomial_bound
endpoints.expanded_type: ∀ (t a : ℝ), 0 < a → t ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / a)) ≤ a

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.norm_gaussianAbsoluteFace_section_density_le
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (t : ℝ),
      ‖ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 t *
            (|t| * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j t)‖ ≤
        RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianAbsoluteFaceDensityBudget r

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace_update_increment_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (c d : ℝ),
      ‖RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace u (Function.update b j c) j -
            RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace u (Function.update b j d) j‖ ≤
        RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianAbsoluteFaceDensityBudget (n + 1) * |c - d|

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lipschitzWith_gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace_update
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    LipschitzWith ⟨RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianAbsoluteFaceDensityBudget (n + 1), ⋯⟩ fun t =>
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace u (Function.update b j t) j
